items.raw_excerpt: Detroit Tigers infielder Lee Hao-yu (李灝宇) hit his seventh home run of the 2026 Major League Baseball (MLB) season on Saturday, moving him within two of the single-season record for homers by a Taiwanese MLB player.
items.summary_en: Detroit Tigers infielder Lee Hao-yu hit his seventh home run of the 2026 MLB season on Saturday. He now sits just two homers away from the all-time single-season record for a Taiwanese player in Major League Baseball.
items.summary_ko: 디트로이트 타이거즈의 내야수 이하오위가 2026시즌 MLB에서 일곱 번째 홈런을 기록했다. 그는 대만 선수 MLB 단일 시즌 홈런 기록까지 단 두 개만을 남겨두고 있다.
items.title_en: Lee Hao-yu hits seventh home run, nears Taiwanese MLB record
items.title_ko: 이하오위, 시즌 7호 홈런으로 대만 MLB 단일 시즌 기록에 바짝 다가서
items.title_original: Taiwan's Lee nears homer milestone in Tigers loss to Royals

items.raw_excerpt: Videos of extreme cleaning posted on social media often go viral and are watched millions of times.
items.summary_en: Videos of extreme cleaning and hoarder home transformations often go viral on social media and attract millions of viewers. The fascination with watching cluttered spaces become spotless has become a global phenomenon.
items.summary_ko: 극도의 청소와 가득 찬 집이 변하는 영상은 소셜미디어에서 자주 바이럴이 되며 수백만 회 조회됩니다. 어지럽고 가득 찬 공간이 깨끗하게 변해가는 모습을 지켜보는 매력은 전 세계적인 현상이 되었습니다.
items.title_en: Why we can't look away from hoarder home clean-ups
items.title_ko: 왜 우리는 집 정리 영상에서 눈을 뗄 수 없는가
items.title_original: Why we can't look away from hoarder home clean-ups

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwanese badminton veteran Chou Tien-chen (周天成) fell just short Saturday of becoming the oldest player to reach a badminton World Championships men's singles final, falling to Japan's Kodai Naraoka in the semifinals in New Delhi.
items.summary_en: Taiwanese badminton player Chou Tien-chen lost to Japan's Kodai Naraoka in the semifinals of the World Championships in New Delhi. The 35-year-old fell just short of becoming the oldest player to reach the men's singles final.
items.summary_ko: 대만 배드민턴 선수 쑨천성이 뉴델리에서 열린 세계선수권대회 4강전에서 일본의 나라오카 코다이에게 패배했다. 35세인 그는 남자 단식 결승에 진출한 역대 최고령 선수가 될 뻔했다.
items.title_en: Badminton Veteran Chou Tien-chen Falls Short in World Championships Semifinals
items.title_original: Chou Tien-chen ousted in semifinals of World Championships

items.raw_excerpt: The helicopter landing pad on Surtsey, a protected volcanic island off Iceland’s south coast, is set to nearly triple in size. The decision followed the approval by Vestmannaeyjar Town Council of an application submitted by the Surtsey Association. The pad will be expanded from 36 to 100 square metres because the Icelandic Coast Guard specialists consider…
items.summary_en: The helicopter landing pad on Surtsey, a protected volcanic island off Iceland's south coast, is set to nearly triple in size. The Vestmannaeyjar Town Council approved the application from the Surtsey Association. The pad will be expanded from 36 to 100 square metres.
items.summary_ko: 아이슬란드 남부 해안의 보호 화산섬 서트세이에 있는 헬기 이착륙장이 거의 3배로 확장될 예정이다. 베스트만나에이야르 시의회가 서트세이 협회의 신청을 승인하여 면적이 36제곱미터에서 100제곱미터로 늘어난다.
items.title_en: Surtsey Helicopter Pad Set for Major Expansion

items.summary_en: France has new school holiday dates for family planning. New EU banking rules will affect everyday finances. Small businesses must switch to electronic billing soon.

items.raw_excerpt: James Jobson is released from prison a day after a case against him is dropped.
items.summary_en: James Jobson was released from prison one day after the case against him was dropped. The case had been heard in Thetford, England. No further legal action was taken.

items.title_en: Man freed from prison after charge dropped in Thetford

items.raw_excerpt: There was a time when the idea of buying an old, slightly knackered car was about as fashionable as wearing socks with sandals.
items.summary_en: A growing trend called bangernomics promotes buying old, worn-out cars as a smart way to save money. Many people are choosing cheap, aging vehicles instead of expensive new ones. The approach is winning fans in Portugal for being practical and fun.
items.summary_ko: 바거노믹스라는 트렌드는 오래되고 헌차 같은 자동차를 사는 것이 돈을 절약하는 똑똑한 방법이라고 주장한다. 많은 사람들이 비싼 새 차 대신 싸고 오래된 차를 선택하고 있다. 이 방식은 포르투갈에서 실용적이고 재미있다는 평가를 받으며 팬을 늘리고 있다.
items.title_en: Old cheap cars make a comeback in Portugal
items.title_ko: 포르투갈에서 낡고 싼 자동차가 다시 인기다
